d:
Suprim kort ne bilkis bano samuhik balatkar aur hatya mamle men do doshiyon bipin chandr joshi aur pradip mordhiya ki aajivan karavas ki saza par rok lagate hue zamanat de di hai. donon 17 sal se adhik samay se jel men band hain. adalat ne apil men kanuni aur tathyatmak muddon par vichar karte hue yah aadesh diya.
Thank you for watching our video!
